summaries.semantic_outcome: SDL 3.2.10 Plus MP+Nunchuk opens the exact-owned HIDAPI joystick during a 60-second poll with no disconnect/removal. An explicit concurrent kernel MP-event holder sees changing gyro. SDL exposes/enables gyro but all polled angular arrays remain zero. No changing decoded SDL gyro is established; capability or successful value polling is not delivery. The underlying virtual gyro is not physically zero and no model fix follows. This is a bounded consumer observation with a holder precondition, not general SDL acceptance.
